Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.sonitpur.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MACT Sonitpur Chief Administrative Officer / Sheristadar recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the MACT Sonitpur Chief Administrative Officer / Sheristadar recruitment is 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Administrative Officer / Sheristadar post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Chief Administrative Officer / Sheristadar post in the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Sonitpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in any discipline from a recognized University and have at least five years of continuous service as a Senior Administrative Officer (erstwhile Sheristadar) or Head Administrative Officer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Chief Administrative Officer / Sheristadar position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is in the pay band of PB4 ₹30,000-₹1,10,000 with a Grade Pay of ₹14,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the MACT Sonitpur recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Chief Administrative Officer / Sheristadar post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on Seniority-cum-Merit and Interview / Viva-voce.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal Sonitpur, which is www.sonitpur.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates along with the application form.
